integrity: The recurrence follows from structural bijections at the last target level and a separate combinatorial inclusion-exclusion identity. Exhaustive small-frame checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem. Originality comparisons disclose unresolved inaccessible-manuscript and alternate-terminology risks.
scientific_limitations: All frames must be finite labeled ordinal sums of nonempty antichains, with reflexive order accessibility; only onto bounded morphisms are counted. The arithmetic-transition bound does not imply a bit-complexity bound. No conclusion concerns valuation-preserving morphisms or arbitrary posets.
title: Exact enumeration of surjective bounded morphisms between layered Kripke frames
